name: dsh-mud-agent
description: MUD agent plugin for deepseek-harness (pkuxkx): mud-core3 (host engine) + mud-webui (web shell), hosted as an independent npm package workspace

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter mud-workflow build && pnpm --filter mud-core3 gen:typert && pnpm --filter mud-core3 build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-ai/dsh-mud-webui build && pnpm --dir D:/Code/deepseek-harness dsh web --patch D:/Code/dsh-mud-agent/packages/mud-core3/cordis.patch.yml --port 3082
